description: Run console (Build.Rite): run your workspace's app and see what happens as it happens — the build tool's output, the requests the app makes of its local server, the app window's own console, where it went — with commands typed like an editor's terminal (help, run, run <page>, build, rebuild, reload, devtools, stop, status, changes, git status/log/diff/branch, signin, code, folder, clear). Nothing typed is run as a program: each command is done by the desktop app (desktop/lib/runConsole.js, /__vbs/console*).

status.description: Who the app runs as (signedInAs: '' = anonymous), the workspace, its build, its window (consoleStatus).

filter.description: Which lines show: '' all, build, server, app, errors.

hist.description: The commands typed (newest last), for ↑ and ↓.
